title: Smoky Millet Blinis
description: A French-inspired breakfast dish featuring smoky millet blinis with a hint of Russian flair.
instructions: Preheat a non-stick skillet or griddle over medium heat.
In a large bowl, whisk together millet flour, eggs, melted butter, sugar, Russian honey, vanilla extract, and salt.
The batter should still be slightly lumpy.
Using a 1/4 cup measuring cup, scoop the batter onto the skillet or griddle.
Cook for 2-3 minutes or until bubbles appear on the surface and edges start to dry.
Flip and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes or until golden brown.
Serve warm with a dollop of Greek yogurt and fresh raspberries.
Optional: Top with a sprinkle of granulated sugar or a drizzle of Russian honey.
